scope: A floating-looking desktop left/right panel group that remains inside a reserved canvas-safe grid track; grouped mode and selected panel restore correctly after reload.

runtime_contracts.floating_mode: A distinct rounded, raised desktop panel card inside its own reserved dock track; it never overlays the canvas.
runtime_contracts.mobile_behavior: The desktop group controls become one safe drawer; the page canvas remains inert only while the drawer is open.
runtime_contracts.active_panel_restore: The initially selected right dock is no longer reset to the left dock while both saved panels are being restored.

reproduction_and_fix.initial_red: The new browser test first failed because the workspace mode selector had no floating option.
reproduction_and_fix.second_red: After implementing floating mode, reload exposed a startup ordering bug: opening the left panel first caused grouped-state normalization to replace the stored active right panel with left before the right panel had been restored.
reproduction_and_fix.fix: Defer the grouped-panel consistency repair until both saved docks have been initialized, then synchronize the group once the restored pair is available.
reproduction_and_fix.green_regression: The browser test now selects right, saves the workspace profile, reloads, confirms right remains active, resizes to the mobile drawer, and returns to the desktop floating card.
